detail: Members of the federal government publish their leading honorary activities under § 2 (3a) of the Incompatibility and Transparency Act in conjunction with § 9 of the Federal Constitutional Act on the Limitation of Salaries of Public Officials; Parliament publishes the list on the member's page (Transparenz tab, also in the page's JSON export). As of October 2026 Stocker's list contains one entry: chairman of the Wiener Neustadt town band.
